steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Status?

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: Going well. I'm almost to the dining room.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Roger.

steps.name: Ernesto
steps.text: We meet again, Miss Ch'en.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: You should have stayed in bed.

steps.name: Ernesto
steps.text: I wish I could've done that. I also wish that, when I opened my eyes again, all of this would've been over, win or lose.

steps.name: Ernesto
steps.text: Too bad. I couldn't.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: You can't beat me.

steps.name: Ernesto
steps.text: I'm really glad that I identified you two as my greatest foes right at the beginning... We wouldn't have made it this far otherwise.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: You... You don't seem like those maniacs out there. Why are you doing this?

steps.name: Ernesto
steps.text: Let me tell you how I truly feel, now that it's come to this.

steps.name: Ernesto
steps.text: Ms. Candela once said that her father, a former mayor of this city, was a useless piece of trash who, propped up by the Leithanian government, could do nothing but take bribes.

steps.name: Ernesto
steps.text: Before the outraged citizens could kick his office's door in, he fled the country with his wife and daughter.

steps.name: Ernesto
steps.text: Although her father was a piece of trash through and through, as the daughter of the scumbag, she followed her father first to Kazimierz, then to Victoria.

steps.name: Ernesto
steps.text: Through her father, she learned all the ways that wealth could be used. She learned the very meaning of wealth.

steps.name: Ernesto
steps.text: Then, she came back to the city and became its mayor.

steps.name: Ernesto
steps.text: At a time when the resistance was nothing but a huge failure, the city found itself producing the finest liquor, coffee, and confectionaries.

steps.name: Ernesto
steps.text: Dossoles tequila can even be found in Leithanien and Columbia.

steps.name: Ernesto
steps.text: And while the Leithanians and Columbians were bickering at each other, the city transformed into a vacation hotspot of choice among the elite of both sides.

steps.name: Ernesto
steps.text: They had no choice but to follow Ms. Candela's rule: You may never fight here.

steps.name: Ernesto
steps.text: And it's not military might or prowess that makes them willingly follow this rule. It's wealth, entertainment, and all the luxuries this place has to offer.

steps.name: Ernesto
steps.text: It's the city's colorful facade.

steps.name: Ernesto
steps.text: I know that's not how I should see all this.

steps.name: Ernesto
steps.text: But I can't keep myself from thinking this way—

steps.name: Ernesto
steps.text: From a certain point of view, and all things considered, perhaps Ms. Candela loves this country far more than my father.

steps.name: Ernesto
steps.text: All he is doing is blindly chasing this construct of a country. He wants a country called Bolívar.

steps.name: Ernesto
steps.text: Its borders were defined when it was still a colony. Its citizens are those who have always lived on these lands.

steps.name: Ernesto
steps.text: What comes next? How will this country take on the Columbians and Leithanians in this conflict? How will it continue to develop as a country?

steps.name: Ernesto
steps.text: He doesn't know. He doesn't actually know what kind of a country Bolívar is.

steps.name: Ernesto
steps.text: But Ms. Candela found a path forward. She found meaning in its existence, and she plans to make that meaning a reality.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: That's a load of shit.

steps.name: Ernesto
steps.text: It's better than having nothing but empty promises, no?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: In that case, why help your father?

steps.name: Ernesto
steps.text: From the moment I was born, I've watched my father toil away amid the flames of war. I've watched him go from a spirited man to a quiet one.

steps.name: Ernesto
steps.text: I know what kind of person my father is. He's not like those men who chose to give in to the modern world.

steps.name: Ernesto
steps.text: Even though working under Ms. Candela put these thoughts in my head, that doesn't mean I will betray my father.

steps.name: Ernesto
steps.text: But I also cannot deny that these thoughts are getting stronger and stronger. So much that I'm slowly starting to consider the other possibilities there are.

steps.name: Ernesto
steps.text: That's why this operation is something like a crossroads for me.

steps.name: Ernesto
steps.text: I will wholeheartedly help my father in his cause. If he succeeds, then I will continue to help him.

steps.name: Ernesto
steps.text: If he fails, then I will accept my change of heart and become Ms. Candela's supporter.

steps.name: Ernesto
steps.text: Of course, if I die—

steps.name: Ernesto
steps.text: That just means I'm gonna be dead, haha.

steps.name: Ernesto
steps.text: But now is not the time for all of this to end. Not just yet.

steps.name: Ernesto
steps.text: That's why I can't let you through.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: In that case... we've got nothing to say to each other.

steps.name: Ernesto
steps.text: Right, it's been a pleasure, Miss Ch'en.

steps.name: Ernesto
steps.text: If we'd met under any other circumstance, I would have loved to give you and Miss Lin a proper tour of the city.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: I'll pass.

steps.name: Ernesto
steps.text: I thought you'd say that.

steps.name: Ship Guard
steps.text: B Team, send a few men my way.

steps.name: Dim-witted Pancho Subordinate
steps.text: What's up?

steps.name: Quick-witted Pancho Subordinate
steps.text: You know that team that did really well in the championship, LUNG wRATh? Seems like their girl Ch'en is still putting up a fight.

steps.name: Dim-witted Pancho Subordinate
steps.text: The whole ship's our people, and all the other contestants are here. How is she putting up a fight?

steps.name: Quick-witted Pancho Subordinate
steps.text: Apparently she took Ernesto out.

steps.name: Quick-witted Pancho Subordinate
steps.text: Then she's been running up and down the ship, and now the captain's personally going after her.

steps.name: Quick-witted Pancho Subordinate
steps.text: Heh, that's something, and here I brushed it off when Ernesto told us not to underestimate them.

steps.name: Dim-witted Pancho Subordinate
steps.text: Hm? Speaking of, where's the other girl, Lin?

steps.name: Dim-witted Pancho Subordinate
steps.text: I don't see her among the hostages.

steps.name: Quick-witted Pancho Subordinate
steps.text: Who knows. Probably jumped off the ship.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: You called?
Lin Yühsia leaps down from the ceiling above, swiftly dispatching them with two quick chops.

steps.name: Alert Pancho Subordinate
steps.text: Quick! Surround her!

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: (Hui-chieh makes good distractions. There's not too many of them here.)

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: (Let's get this over with quickly.)

a.text: Surrounded by the guards in the room, Lin Yühsia leans forward slightly and dashes.
She rams her knee into the first guard's stomach, sending him flying into a second guard. The two violently crash into a pillar, incapacitating them and almost knocking the pillar over.

The third guard is about to attack with his weapon, but then notices the two streams of blood gushing out of his arm. He screams and falls to his knees, before a single chop turns everything around him black.
The fourth and fifth guards attempt to attack her together, only for Lin Yühsia to kick an entire dining table toward them, tableware included. They crash to the ground before they can react.

Correctly deducing the severity of the situation, the sixth man picks up his comms in an attempt to relay the information, only to find it puffing up smoke. The next moment, he finds himself flying through the air; his body draws an elegant arc before falling into the sea.
Lin Yühsia is particularly skilled in close quarters combat, and she takes full advantage of this in the cramped dining room, dispatching the hostage guards in a flash.
The hostages, in other words the dignitaries kidnapped by the captain and the contestants who got dragged into the mess, are all trembling in the corner, gawking at her in surprise.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: Come with me if you want to live.

steps.name: Dignitary
steps.text: How are we supposed to escape?! The whole ship's full of Pancho's men!

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: You two.

steps.name: Feeble-minded Contestant
steps.text: Eeep—

steps.name: Headstrong Contestant
steps.text: Stop embarrassing yourself. Stand up.

steps.name: Headstrong Contestant
steps.text: Miss Lin, we'll do what you say.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: I'll be the point guard. The rest of you, take care of the bigwigs.

steps.name: Headstrong Contestant
steps.text: Got it.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: Now, then...

steps.name: Rafaela
steps.text: Damn... am I too late...?

steps.name: Rafaela
steps.text: Ernesto said you'd be here. Looks like he was right.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: (Ernesto... Hui-chieh took him out, but he figured the situation right after he came to?)

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: (He's a capable man. What a shame.)

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: (Still, I didn't expect to run into this little girl again.)

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: Little girl, you shouldn't have thrown yourself into this mess.

steps.name: Rafaela
steps.text: My name is Rafaela. I'm not a little girl.

steps.name: Rafaela
steps.text: I may be adopted, but I'm Papa's daughter, so this is exactly the mess I should be in.

steps.name: Rafaela
steps.text: Mi hermano called you a good person. Why are you standing in our way?

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: Do you think what you're doing is right?

steps.name: Rafaela
steps.text: I'm not so sure, but Hermano and Papa said the city's a bad place, and I take their word for it.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: You should form your own opinions, little girl. Sometimes, your elders need your help.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: They have experience, and they can be quite insistent on following that experience.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: When it comes time for you to take over, you can't always do as they did in the past.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: You need to use your own reason to break away from their old ways. You need to think about what only you can do.

steps.name: Rafaela
steps.text: I don't understand.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: It's okay, but you should try to remember this.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: Okay, I still have something else to take care of, so it's time for you to be good and go to bed now, little girl.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: (Grr, how dare that Lin Yühsia hang up on me. Now I can't reach her. What the hell is she doing?!)

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Lin Yühsia, what are you even doing? I heard you rescued the hostages like twenty minutes ago, and now most of their men are coming after you.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: I know. I'm not with the hostages right now. My guess is they've gotten out.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: What are you...

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: Trust me. Come to the basement. Together, we'll...
Ch'en puts her phone down and turns around in an instant. Pancho and his men are standing not too far away.

steps.name: Pancho
steps.text: I've heard stories of what an impressive man the Chief of Lungmen Wei Yenwu is.

steps.name: Pancho
steps.text: You may be no less formidable, but neither of you have a clear head, and he sent you two nonetheless.

steps.name: Pancho
steps.text: Looks like Wei Yenwu is no more impressive than Candela.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: You...

steps.name: Pancho
steps.text: You people see nothing but money. There is nothing but leisure on your mind. I can't wait to slaughter all of you.

steps.name: Pancho
steps.text: I don't know what Lungmen is like, but ever since I was born, there's been blood gushing out of Bolívar's veins.

steps.name: Pancho
steps.text: Who doesn't want to shake hands and live in happiness? But none of us here can do that.

steps.name: Pancho
steps.text: Let me tell you this. It doesn't matter how much blood we spill. This city sucks far more blood in a single day!

steps.name: Pancho
steps.text: Alright, I've had enough of your games.

steps.name: Pancho
steps.text: Give it up, or this is where you die.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: (Why are you doing this? Do you really think this is right, in spite of how much more blood you'll spill?)

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: (None of those questions matter to him...)

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: (In his eyes, I'm the one who's disrupting his plans, and besides—)

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: (I can't argue with him.)

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: (Not because I regret what I've done.)

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: (In fact, it's because I do agree with him, now that I understand his motives.)

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: (Even if I disagree with his methods.)

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: (But I don't understand Bolívar well enough, and I don't understand war well enough. I can't come up with a better solution.)

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: (That's why I can't argue with him.)

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: (That's why I can't draw my blade.)

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: (Chi Xiao definitely won't accept me as I am now. I can tell.)

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: (In that case, there's only one thing I can do—)
Ch'en slowly lifts her gun.

steps.name: Pancho
steps.text: So you have chosen death.
Likewise, Pancho slowly lifts the anchor in his hands.
Right at that moment—

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: Jump, Hui-chieh.

a.text: With no time to think, Ch'en leaps off the deck of the ship.

steps.text: Lin Yühsia is waiting underneath with a boat.

steps.name: Pancho
steps.text: Gah, after them!
